title: 意味上の領域があるDOMテストはwithinで探索範囲を限定する

source.section: テスト構造 > 基本原則

question.instructions: Classify whether DOM tests scope their queries to a meaningful user-observable region with within when the screen contains a semantic region relevant to the assertion.

criteria.violation: A test searches the entire document for an element even though the UI has a meaningful user-observable region that should first be selected and then searched with within, making the tested contract unnecessarily ambiguous.
criteria.compliant: When a meaningful region exists and matters to the contract, the test selects that region through a user-observable query and uses within to search inside it. Global queries are used only when scoping is unnecessary.
criteria.not_applicable: The tested UI has no meaningful region relevant to the query, or the file contains no DOM test to which scoped querying applies.
criteria.insufficient_context: The available source does not show enough of the rendered UI contract to determine whether a meaningful region exists for scoping.
